source: Belfield, S. and Brown, C. (2010). Guidebook on Upland Crops in Cambodia: Corn (សៀវភៅណែនាំ ស្តីពីដំណាំតំបន់ខ្ពង់រាបនៅក្នុងប្រទេសកម្ពុជា៖ ដំណាំពោត). ACIAR Monograph 143, published by the Australian Centre for International Agricultural Research (ACIAR) in partnership with NSW Department of Primary Industries, the Cambodian Agricultural Research and Development Institute (CARDI), Murdoch University, University of Canberra, and MAFF, under ACIAR Project ASEM/2000/109. Uploaded PDF, 52 pages, image-only (Limon-font-era scan, read via page rasterization).
text:
National corn production data (MAFF Cambodia, Agricultural Statistics 2002-03, 2003-04, 2004-05), broken down by white corn and yellow corn:

- 2002-03: White corn -- 71,564 ha, approximately 148,447 tonnes, yield 2.08 t/ha. Yellow corn -- 50,265 ha, approximately 117,344 tonnes, yield 2.33 t/ha. Combined total -- approximately 121,856 ha, approximately 266,241 tonnes.
- 2003-04: White corn -- 83,563 ha, approximately 314,601 tonnes, yield 3.75 t/ha. Yellow corn -- 65,556 ha, approximately 287,364 tonnes, yield 4.38 t/ha. Combined total -- approximately 146,506 ha, approximately 602,265 tonnes.
- 2004-05: White corn -- 77,304 ha, approximately 256,335 tonnes, yield 3.32 t/ha. Yellow corn -- 57,418 ha, approximately 223,656 tonnes, yield 3.80 t/ha. Combined total -- approximately 134,722 ha, approximately 480,361 tonnes.

Confidence note: these multi-digit tonnage figures were read from a small-font scanned table; the area and yield figures were cross-checked against each other (area x yield closely matches the stated tonnage in each row) and are considered reliable, but the exact last one or two digits of some tonnage figures should be treated as approximate pending verification against the original MAFF statistics.

Elsewhere, this source also states that corn area nationally grew from about 50,000 tonnes produced per year historically (an early, smaller baseline) up to national totals of around 748,000 tonnes by 2016 in separate MAFF figures cited in other batches of this knowledge base -- illustrating substantial growth in Cambodian corn production over the following decade.
